topicName: What are PL/SQL packages and what are their benefits?
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"What are PL/SQL packages and what are their benefits?"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"PL/SQL packages are schema objects that group logically related PL/SQL types, variables, constants, subprograms (procedures and functions), cursors, and exceptions. They provide modularity, encapsulation, and information hiding, improving code organization and maintainability."}]
